crossRefs.note: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations…
Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys…
For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the…
Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries…
for our God is a consuming fire.

people.name: Gog
people.line: A symbolic enemy of God's people in prophetic literature.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.
translations.bsb: Now on that day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, declares the Lord GOD, My wrath will flare up.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah, that my wrath shall come up into my nostrils.
